tasks.short: Maintain records of compliance complaints and investigation outcomes

loop.output: dated facts, people, actions and missing fields
loop.check: The manager checks extracted facts against the underlying complaint and outcome.
loop.stop: Stop after one extraction; leave unclear fields blank for manual completion.
loop.why_not_simpler: Complaint narratives and investigation outcomes contain variable free text.

tasks.design: A configured compliance case in the {WORKFLOW} receives complaints and investigation outcomes and links their source documents in the {DOCS}. It extracts candidate record fields, but the compliance manager checks completeness and sets retention or follow-up dates.
tasks.previous_blocker: Complaint and investigation records were assembled from mail and documents after the event.
tasks.enabler_now: A case record can require standard metadata and retain a source link beside each extracted fact.
tasks.still_hard: Completeness, retention and follow-up depend on the facts and the applicable rule.
tasks.human_edge: The manager recognises material omissions and the consequences of retaining or closing a record.

ambition.what: review recurring complaint themes from complete case records

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time filing individual documents and more time improving controls from case patterns.

evidence.claim: A structured case workflow can require fields and link documents for human review.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: complaint or investigation outcome through complete retained compliance record.

Input contract: case id, reporter, event date, issue category, outcome, owner and source-document link are supplied by the originating process; missing fields are entered manually and document text is extracted for review.
Native {WORKFLOW} record and retention features are tested before custom code.
The incremental allowance covers mandatory-field and retention-rule changes.
unknowns: Which complaint categories, retention periods and source systems apply.
research_questions: Which fields are mandatory for a closed investigation record?

already_counted.description: Check extracted facts and required case fields.

incremental.description: Maintain required fields and retention rules.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative scenarios retain completeness and retention judgement and deduct 4 focal-role upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours; provisional, not measured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult corporate attorneys on difficult legal compliance issues

steps.what: Collect facts for the legal compliance issue

loop.input: legal issue file and policy text
loop.output: question brief, chronology and evidence index
loop.check: The compliance manager verifies the chronology, wording and all cited evidence.
loop.stop: Draft once; return missing facts to the case owner.
loop.why_not_simpler: The issue file needs a concise narrative assembled from unstructured evidence.

steps.what: Discuss legal compliance issue with attorney

tasks.design: The {WORKFLOW} assembles a dated legal issue file from links in the {DOCS} and prepares an attorney question brief. The compliance manager validates the brief, holds the attorney consultation, and records the advice and required action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Legal consultations began with a manually assembled chronology and incomplete evidence pack.
tasks.enabler_now: A structured case brief can make the question, chronology and evidence links reusable without interpreting legal advice.
tasks.still_hard: Attorney-client advice, legal interpretation and the response to it remain human work.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows the operational context and can test whether counsel’s advice is workable.
tasks.altitude: The manager arrives at legal consultations prepared and spends the saved time implementing advice with owners.

reach.learn: how to translate advice into an obligation and deadline

evidence.claim: A structured issue file can prepare a chronology and evidence index for human legal review.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: difficult legal question through recorded advice and action.
Input contract: case id, question, chronology, policy reference, evidence links and owner are supplied by the case owner; missing facts are manually entered and document text is extracted for review.
Native {WORKFLOW} case and {DOCS} access controls are tested before custom code.
The incremental allowance covers brief templates and access permissions.
unknowns: Which matters require privileged handling and which attorney records may be retained in the case workflow.
research_questions: Can privileged advice be linked without copying it into general compliance records?

already_counted.description: Validate the attorney brief and record advice.

incremental.description: Maintain the attorney brief template and access rules.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative scenarios retain the consultation and review of legal advice and deduct 2 focal-role upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours; provisional, not measured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct or direct an internal compliance investigation

steps.what: Conclude compliance investigation and recommend action

tasks.design: The {WORKFLOW} holds the investigation plan, access-controlled evidence index and interview schedule, with source material in the {DOCS}. It reduces administrative organisation, while the compliance manager leads interviews, tests allegations and reaches the conclusion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence collection and interview coordination were interwoven with the investigation judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: An access-controlled evidence index and interview checklist can remove clerical organisation without deciding the case.
tasks.still_hard: Fair interviewing, credibility assessment and the conclusion need context, trust and accountability.
tasks.human_edge: The investigator reads inconsistencies, protects participants and weighs evidence fairly.
tasks.altitude: The manager has more time to test evidence and improve the investigation method.

evidence.claim: An access-controlled case record can organise investigation evidence for human review.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: compliance issue through internal investigation conclusion.

Input contract: case id, allegation, scope, evidence link, witness list, owner and confidentiality marking are supplied by the intake owner; missing fields are manually entered and document text is extracted for review.
Native {WORKFLOW} permissions and {DOCS} access controls are tested before custom code.
The incremental allowance covers checklist and permission changes.
unknowns: Which cases need independent investigators, how evidence must be preserved, and which participants need extra protection.
research_questions: Which evidence and interview records must remain outside the general case workflow?

incremental.description: Maintain investigation checklists and access groups.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative scenarios retain all interviews and conclusions, and deduct 2 focal-role upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours; provisional, not measured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide employee compliance training on policies and procedures

loop.output: training outline, examples and knowledge-check questions
loop.check: The manager checks every instruction against the approved policy before delivery.
loop.stop: Produce one draft; flag policy gaps for manual revision.
loop.why_not_simpler: Policy text must be rewritten into understandable learning material for different employee groups.

tasks.design: The {LMS} receives role-based training audiences from the {HCM} and records completion. A bounded drafting step prepares policy-based learning material from the {DOCS}; the compliance manager delivers the training and uses employee questions to improve it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Audience lists, policy material, attendance and questions were maintained in separate files.
tasks.enabler_now: Role data, completion records and source-linked policy material can be connected in the learning workflow.
tasks.still_hard: Employees need a credible human explanation of how policy applies to their work.
tasks.human_edge: The trainer handles sensitive questions and identifies when a policy is unclear in practice.

ambition.what: give new frontline supervisors a role-specific compliance induction

tasks.altitude: The manager improves policy adoption from question patterns instead of chasing attendance lists.

evidence.claim: A learning workflow can maintain enrolments and completion records.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: policy training assignment through completion record and employee questions.

Input contract: employee id, role, policy version, due date, module link, attendance and assessment result are supplied by the training owner; missing values are entered manually and policy text is extracted for review.
Native {LMS} enrolment and completion configuration is tested before custom code.
The incremental allowance covers role mappings and training-material updates.
unknowns: Which training is mandatory, how role changes trigger enrolment, and whether the current LMS supports question capture.
research_questions: Which employee groups need facilitated training rather than self-study?

incremental.description: Maintain role mappings and policy training materials.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative scenarios retain all training delivery and half the question review, and deduct 4 focal-role upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours; provisional, not measured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Improve compliance controls, legal brief quality and policy adoption rather than maintaining routine records.
reach: Internal auditor: test evidence and record controls.
role.ambitious_version: Use complete compliance records and employee questions to prevent recurring control failures.
